passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
signIn.title: Pick up where you left off.
signIn.intro: Sign in with the username and password from your course team. Your course history stays with your account.
signIn.introPasskeys: Sign in with the username and password from your course team, or with a passkey you have added. Your course history stays with your account.
languageSaveFailed: Your language choice applies here, but it could not be saved to your account. It will be tried again next time you choose.
native.title: Connected learning
native.body: Use the web learner while native account transport is being integrated.
closedHelp.exhausted: This course is closed and every question it allows after closing has been used. Your saved conversation and the course material stay available to read.
closedHelp.remaining: This course is closed. You can still ask {remaining, plural, one {# more question} other {# more questions}} about its material. Questions never change your results.
closedHelp.remainingOfBudget: This course is closed. You can still ask {remaining, plural, one {# more question} other {# more questions}} about its material ({used, number} of {budget, number} used). Questions never change your results.
notice.recoveredMessage: Your saved message was recovered. Open the companion to see its status before sending another message.
notice.progressSaved: Your progress is saved. Continue along your learning path.
notice.reviewRequested: Your review request was sent. A staff member will respond here; your saved work is unchanged.
notice.extensionGranted: Your extension was granted. The saved dates and remaining allowance have been refreshed.
notice.extensionAwaitingApproval: Your acceptance is saved. The extension is waiting for approval; current dates still apply.
notice.offerDeclined: The offer was declined. Your existing dates remain in effect.
notice.dataErased: Your learning data for this course was erased.
error.offline: You’re offline. Nothing was recorded yet; your work is saved on this device and is sent when you reconnect.
error.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Your draft is preserved. Please retry.
error.queuedRefreshFailed: Your message is saved and queued, but progress could not refresh. Refresh before continuing.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Drafts and pending retries stay in this tab only; confirm any interrupted request before closing it.
library.title: Your courses
library.erased: You erased your learning data for this version, so it cannot be resumed. Ask your course team if you want to start again.
library.empty: No published course is available yet. Your course team can publish a course for you.
record.title: Your learning record
record.intro: Saved reading, practice, and independent checks. Only verified checks count toward completion.
